name: vianido
description: Find nonprofits and read what they're working on, from the AI assistant you already use. If you manage one on Vianido, keep its profile current and post its updates.

interface.longDescription: Most nonprofits can't afford to be found. Vianido gives them one place to share their work and talk with supporters. With this plugin, your AI assistant can find nonprofits, read and compare their Vianido profiles, and link to them. If you manage an organization on Vianido, it can keep the profile current and post its updates for you.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find nonprofits working on food access in my city on Vianido and compare what they do.
